'''Edge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Imperial Assassin]] who operated during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Edge mortally wounded [[Eaden Vrill]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], and was killed shortly afterward by [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|LE-BO2D9]].

==Biography==
Edge was an assassin operating under the Galactic Empire, and was sent during its early years to hunt down and kill [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals. Edge's work brought him to the aquatic world [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]], home of the order of the [[Sälãi Käsi]]. A clan of Force-intuitive [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] warriors who studied the art of [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]], the order was deemed a threat by the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]. Edge infiltrated their temple and slaughtered the order, including the esteemed headmaster [[Neaed Fisto]], the uncle of renowned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. [[Eaden Vrill]], his sister, and his cousin were the only survivors of the massacre.
